name: Charge Verification Agent
description: Investigates unrecognized or suspicious charges on customer accounts and handles disputes

skills.name: Charge Lookup
skills.description: Look up charge details from transaction history
examples: What charges do I have from TechStore Pro?

skills.name: Charge Dispute
skills.description: Handle dispute process for unrecognized charges
examples: I want to dispute this charge

skills.name: Card Replacement Delegation
skills.description: Delegate to Card Replacement Agent when fraud is suspected
examples: Replace my card because of fraud
